mapper.select: WITH returns_by_consumption AS ( SELECT r.consumption_id,SUM(r.returned_qty) AS returned_qty FROM material_return r JOIN material_consumption c ON c.consumption_id=r.consumption_id WHERE c.raw_lot_id=#{rawLotId} GROUP BY r.consumption_id ), material_totals AS ( SELECT c.work_order_id,SUM(c.consumed_qty) AS consumed_qty, SUM(COALESCE(r.returned_qty,0)) AS returned_qty FROM material_consumption c LEFT JOIN returns_by_consumption r ON r.consumption_id=c.consumption_id WHERE c.raw_lot_id=#{rawLotId} GROUP BY c.work_order_id ), related_lots AS ( SELECT f.finished_lot_id FROM finished_goods_lot f JOIN material_totals m ON m.work_order_id=f.work_order_id ), production_totals AS ( SELECT p.finished_lot_id,COUNT(*) AS result_count,SUM(p.produced_qty) AS produced_qty, SUM(p.good_qty) AS good_qty,SUM(p.defect_qty) AS defect_qty FROM production_result p JOIN related_lots l ON l.finished_lot_id=p.finished_lot_id GROUP BY p.finished_lot_id ), inspection_totals AS ( SELECT q.finished_lot_id,SUM(q.inspected_qty) AS inspected_qty,SUM(q.accepted_qty) AS accepted_qty, SUM(q.rejected_qty) AS rejected_qty,MAX(q.round_no) AS last_round_no FROM quality_inspection q JOIN related_lots l ON l.finished_lot_id=q.finished_lot_id GROUP BY q.finished_lot_id ) SELECT m.consumed_qty,m.returned_qty, w.work_order_id AS w_work_order_id,w.status AS w_status,w.product_unit_code AS w_product_unit_code, w.inspection_target_qty AS w_inspection_target_qty,i.item_code AS w_product_code,i.item_name AS w_product_name, f.finished_lot_id AS f_finished_lot_id,f.lot_no AS f_lot_no, COALESCE(p.result_count,0) AS f_result_count,COALESCE(p.produced_qty,0) AS f_produced_qty, COALESCE(p.good_qty,0) AS f_good_qty,COALESCE(p.defect_qty,0) AS f_defect_qty, f.finished_lot_id AS q_finished_lot_id,w.inspection_target_qty AS q_inspection_target_qty, COALESCE(q.inspected_qty,0) AS q_inspected_qty,COALESCE(q.accepted_qty,0) AS q_accepted_qty, COALESCE(q.rejected_qty,0) AS q_rejected_qty,COALESCE(q.last_round_no,0) AS q_last_round_no FROM material_totals m JOIN work_order w ON w.work_order_id=m.work_order_id JOIN item i ON i.item_id=w.product_item_id LEFT JOIN finished_goods_lot f ON f.work_order_id=w.work_order_id LEFT JOIN production_totals p ON p.finished_lot_id=f.finished_lot_id LEFT JOIN inspection_totals q ON q.finished_lot_id=f.finished_lot_id ORDER BY w.work_order_id DESC
